title: ccp16_utilization.json: Oracle provenance inconsistent with vector 7 expected SF
description: Line 127: Vector 'utilization_high_with_sf7_baseline' expects sf=10, but the oracle_provenance (line 6) states 'if utilization > 150: SF += 2; if utilization > 200: return (SF, false)' which would produce sf=9 (7+2=9). The vector description claims '+1 for util>200' but this rule is absent from the oracle. Either the oracle_provenance is incomplete (missing the +1 rule) or the expected sf should be 9, not 10.
close_reason: Fixed oracle_provenance to say 'return (12, false)' matching spec pseudocode, and updated sf_adjustment_reason to accurately describe the behavior
